posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible on the posterior thigh, forming a geometric line parallel to the ground approximately midway between the hip and the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the lateral mandible area. Large, rounded pinnae with high-contrast white internal fringe.
